title: Turn off monitor power save when mirroring screen
line: Screens no longer dim, turn off or lock on idle while they are mirrored, like notifications are already silenced.
explanation: Plasma already turns on Do Not Disturb when screens are mirrored, since that usually means a presentation, but power management ignored it: after the idle timeout the screens dimmed, turned off and locked in the middle of a presentation. The change makes powerdevil watch the screens with the same overlap check the notification code uses and, while any screens are mirrored, hold its own screen power management inhibition ("Display Configuration: Screens are mirrored"), released as soon as they stop being mirrored or the output is unplugged.

commits.message:
daemon: Keep screens on while they are mirrored

Screens dimmed, turned off and locked on idle even while mirrored, which
usually means a presentation is going on. Like notifications already do,
add a screen power management inhibition while any screens overlap.

BUG: 495738

media.caption: Two mirrored screens: nothing keeps them on, both turn off after the 30 s idle timeout
Same setup: the Power & Battery popup lists the mirroring block (with Unblock) and the screens stay on
